title: 类目明细销售额
query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：统计2026年8月1日至22日下单且订单实付金额大于0的订单，按商品类目名称汇总订单明细实付金额，取金额最高的10类。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: SELECT pc.category_name AS "商品类目名称", SUM(oi.paid_amount) AS "订单明细实付金额" FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_categories pc ON p.category_id = pc.category_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23 00:00:00' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY pc.category_name ORDER BY SUM(oi.paid_amount) DESC LIMIT 10
result.analysis: 结果返回了符合条件的10个商品类目及对应订单明细实付金额合计。其中箱包配饰以74668.70999999999元最高，运动鞋服以51099.59999999999元位列第10。
